items.stem: A startup documents one model thoroughly and says it has 'implemented ISO/IEC 42001.' What is missing?

options.text: A management system is organisation-wide: policy, roles, planning, operation, audit and review, not a single model's documentation
options.rationale: Correct: 42001 defines a management system, not a per-model artefact.

options.text: Nothing, one strong model file is sufficient
options.rationale: A management system spans the organisation and its lifecycle.

options.text: It also needs a published research paper
options.rationale: Publication is unrelated to a management system.

options.text: Only a privacy policy is required
options.rationale: A privacy policy alone is not an AI management system.

items.explanation: Correct: 42001 defines a management system, not a per-model artefact.

items.stem: Which TWO activities fit the 'Check' stage of Plan-Do-Check-Act for an AI management system? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Conducting an internal audit against the system's requirements
options.rationale: Correct: internal audit is a Check activity.

options.text: Holding a management review of objectives and performance
options.rationale: Correct: management review is a Check activity.

options.text: Writing the AI policy and objectives

items.explanation: Correct: internal audit is a Check activity.

items.stem: An auditor finds a control is defined but never executed. What is the correct management-system response?

options.text: Raise a nonconformity and open a corrective action to fix the cause
options.rationale: Correct: nonconformity and corrective action drive continual improvement.

options.text: Delete the control so there is no gap on paper
options.rationale: Removing a needed control hides the problem rather than fixing it.

options.text: Ignore it because the control exists in writing
options.rationale: A control that is not performed is a real nonconformity.

options.text: Wait for the next certification cycle
options.rationale: Corrective action should not be deferred by default.

items.explanation: Correct: nonconformity and corrective action drive continual improvement.
